title: Convention of 1800
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Convention of 1800", at revision 1382429493, opens: "The Convention of 1800, also known as the Treaty of Mortefontaine, was signed on September 30, 1800, by the United States and France. The difference in name was due to congressional sensitivity at entering into treaties, due to disputes over the 1778 treaties of Alliance and Commerce between France and the U.S." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q284553, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Treaty between the U.S. and France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
